cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 w/ Radeon 890M
measurement: Sequential fresh children after builds/tests stop. One separate Stage/Recorder publisher per real .pgs; all query children only parse/typecheck and load that evidence (Stage=0). Native cuts one 64-state/512-edge/64-binding slice with no output. Topology frontier cuts one 64/512/64/256 slice; formula cuts after half the physical-node count in formula states. Save clocks exclude prefix work; original task/view destroyed before a fresh view opens, and restore clocks exclude fresh-view metadata loading. Restore must preserve all logical counters; continuation uses 64/512/64/256 slices. Memory mode retains state after v1 native/v3 topology save; paged native and v4 topology offload drop task-owned buffers before destruction. Owned capacity is sampled at advance boundaries, not continuous allocation peak; native directory is separate, topology hash accounting includes values/buckets but excludes links. Codec buffer high-water is retained vector capacity observed in segmented topology IO, excluding CAS envelope scratch and directory metadata. Task read requests include missing probes, head and dedup verification; they are not physical device IO. Disk includes CAS envelopes, old/unpublished objects, head and marker; native paging may append leaves after the last saved head. Topology save_cas_added counts new CAS bytes, excluding head replacement; amplification ratios use its fixed-record logical_table_bytes, excluding control/directories. Native paging read/write telemetry covers the restored backend only. wait4 whole-child RSS includes front end, graph cache, saved/restored state, result digest/compatibility copies and destruction; no RSS or constant-time restore claim. Warm OS page cache, no cache flushing, pinning or fixed frequency. Smoke is correctness only.
